regressionCoverage.description: Full suite re-run after every change in this branch, most recently after the Pass 16 performance-fix pass: the real 2026-09-16 production timeout (RUN_AURA_CAMPANA_A_REGENERATE_DRY_RUN exceeded Apps Script max execution time for ~227 contacts) was root-caused to the O(n^2) growing-table upsert pattern in v6UpsertByKey_ being called once per contact/row across ingest, scope-build, recipient resolution, queue build, preflight and dispatch, and fixed via a new v6BatchUpsertByKey_ primitive (MarketingV6FrequencyControl.gs, one full read + in-memory merge + one full write) adopted everywhere this pipeline writes, an additive batchWrite:true opt-in on the shared v6ResolveRecipients_/v6AuraEnsureCampaignScope_ (default behavior unchanged, every existing caller/test unaffected), a preloaded-ledger optional argument on v6FrequencyStatus_, a dedicated in-memory Campana A batch dispatcher (v6AuraCampanaADispatchBatch_) replacing the shared per-job-I/O auraProcessEmailQueue for this pipeline only, per-phase timing instrumentation, and Script-Property-based checkpoint/resume for the per-contact build loop. All previously-recorded pre-existing failures (7 files, unrelated V5.5/legacy frontend assertions, see history below) remain absent from the current tree -- the full suite is green (37/37).
regressionCoverage.history: Pass 4's regression run recorded 24 files / 17 passed / 7 failed, with the 7 failures independently reproduced on main via git stash (stale index.html cache-busting version strings and V5.5 frontend/backend-adapter assertions unrelated to any Retention V1 file). As of Pass 5 through 15's runs (node --test tests/*.test.js), all 7 of those previously-failing files pass; nothing in any of these passes touched any of them, so no fix was authored here -- this note only records that the full suite is currently green end to end (37 files total; Pass 15 extended tests/v6-aura-campana-a.test.js in place rather than adding a new test file -- its frontend/legacy-router changes have no Node test harness and were verified by syntax check plus live-content diffing instead).
